listen_address.description: IP address the WHOIS server should bind to (e.g., '127.0.0.1' or '0.0.0.0' for all interfaces).

listen_port.description: Port number the WHOIS server listens on (standard WHOIS port is 43).

server_name.description: Public hostname or identifier for this WHOIS server instance.

server_contact.description: Email address or contact info for the server operator.

log_level.description: Verbosity of logging: 'error', 'warn', 'info', 'debug' (gwhois uses standard syslog-like levels).

log_file.description: Path to the log file for server events.

use_file_backend.description: If true, use the built-in file-backed WHOIS database instead of external sources.

whois_db_file.description: Path to the plain-text WHOIS database file (domain → contact data mapping).

batch_mode.description: Enable batch mode to handle multiple queries in one connection (e.g., via pipelined input).

batch_max_queries.description: Maximum number of queries allowed per batch connection (used only if batch_mode=true).

batch_timeout.description: Timeout (seconds) for the entire batch session (used only if batch_mode=true).

enable_reverse.description: Enable reverse WHOIS lookup by IP prefix (e.g., for network operators).

reverse_prefix_file.description: Path to the IP prefix → owner mapping file (required if enable_reverse=true).

rate_limit_enabled.description: Enable per-IP request rate limiting to prevent abuse.

rate_limit_requests_per_ip.description: Max requests allowed per IP within the rate-limit window (used only if rate_limit_enabled=true).

rate_limit_window_seconds.description: Time window (seconds) for rate limiting (used only if rate_limit_enabled=true).

default: # The Whois Service is provided by the operator.
response_suffixes.description: List of suffix lines appended to every WHOIS response.
